title: Concrete scalar-unit augmentation presentation data
statement: On a Grothendieck site with sheafification, a sheaf R of commutative rings and V in the site, define the actual module extension, scalar extension and scalar restriction functors on unbounded complexes, their total-tensor source and slice source, their coefficient-level targets, and their pure-section generators. StrictTotals records the prescribed two-coefficient transition formulas and laws. Augmentation records the normalized ordinary and coefficient comparisons, scalar-unit maps, augmentation square and its functorial localization. These are exactly the presentation definitions of lem-sf-open-tensor-scalar-unit-augmentation; all names, universes, types, and construction bodies are preserved.
